label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/sql-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink value is "SELECT * FROM " + param + " WHERE active=1" where param comes directly from request.getParameter("BenchmarkTest"). Although there is a regex allowlist check (^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$), this only restricts character sets and does not prevent SQL injection entirely. User-controlled table names remain attacker-controllable within the allowed character range, enabling table enumeration attacks. The allowlist does not sanitize or encode the value before it reaches the SQL execution sink.

evidence.note: Regex allowlist only restricts character set, does not prevent SQL injection at sink
Sink: param concatenated directly into SQL table name position
